S.FORM: alang Mintuyu ga niya mki sku Sincik Keng atu Gpho go, kwara sali buwan nya ga 54 buwan, 166 hi ku kwara s'uli tayan. s'uli tayan pinspngan Gyencumin ga 93% kyan ku 154 hi, binah ga, 'yat kahun sku pinspngan Gyencumin ga 7% kyan ku 12 hi nya. pinspung na linhuyan Gyencumin ga, Tayan 90%, saySiyat 2%, Puyuma 1%. maki qu ngasal bziran. rhzyal kki'an tay 'llaw na Mintuyu hya' ga rgyax krahu'. tay 'zil na Mintuyu hya' ga llyung. tay mkyahu' na Mintuyu hya' ga llyung. tay mkraya' na Mintuyu hya' ga llyung. tay 'zil na Mintuyu hya' ga Heku'. tay mkyahu' na Mintuyu hya' ga Ulay. rekisi kayal kyokay ssquliq pinlpgan ppqbaqan pqwasan biru 'laqi' cikuy pqwasan biru 'laqi' mrkyas tuqi 'san basu kisya' glgan spyangan na pinbahu Ubuy qqmayh
S.PHON: alaŋ mintuju ɣa nija mki [s|ɕ]ku [s|ɕ]in[ʦ|ʨ]ik keŋ atu ɣpħo ɣo kwara [s|ɕ]ali βuwan nja ɣa ** βuwan *** ħi ku kwara [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku *** ħi βinaħ ɣa ʔjat kaħun [s|ɕ]ku pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa * kjan ku ** ħi nja pin[s|ɕ]puŋ na linħujan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa tajan ** [s|ɕ]aj[s|ɕ]ijat * pujuma * maki qu ŋa[s|ɕ]al βziran rħzjal kkiʔan taj ʔllaw na mintuju ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax kraħuʔ taj ʔzil na mintuju ħjaʔ ɣa lljuŋ taj mkjaħuʔ na mintuju ħjaʔ ɣa lljuŋ taj mkrajaʔ na mintuju ħjaʔ ɣa lljuŋ taj ʔzil na mintuju ħjaʔ ɣa ħekuʔ taj mkjaħuʔ na mintuju ħjaʔ ɣa ulaj reki[s|ɕ]i kajal kjokaj [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]quliq pinlpɣan ppqβaqan pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ [ʦ|ʨ]ikuj pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ mrkja[s|ɕ] tuqi ʔ[s|ɕ]an βa[s|ɕ]u ki[s|ɕ]jaʔ ɣlɣan [s|ɕ]pjaŋan na pinβaħu uβuj qqmajħ
